description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to tenant management within a frontend application, including functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenants associated with the current session from the backend API.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant by ID, updates localStorage, and makes a POST request to the backend to set the active tenant.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in localStorage and removes any legacy keys.
